title: Chiefs Weekly Pocket Briefing — May 18
content:
Purpose: quick, packable briefing for the chiefs' weekly — two-minute drills per topic and three clear asks we need the room to resolve. Use this as the ‘pocket playlist’ before the meeting and drop a short update into #exec-briefing 15 minutes ahead.

Logistics:
- Meeting: Exec staff weekly (Thu 09:00 PT) — 50 min
- Room: Zoom / Main channel; AV check at 08:55
- Goal: unblock decisions that move Dedicated GA runway and clarify go/no-go for the Private pilot cohort next month.

TL;DR (for busy chiefs)
- Traffic: Hosted API stable; 95th p99 token latency down 12% from last week with batching tweaks.
- Capacity: Dedicated cluster (eu-west) still below targeted throughput — scheduling follow-up infra burst on Mon.
- Risk: Private pilot compliance review outstanding (GRC) — blocks customer go-live for 3 pilots.
- Asks (priority): 1) Approve 2-week burst spend for Dedicated EU, 2) greenlight delayed compliance remediation hire (contractor), 3) confirm fallback SLA language for pilot customers.

Agenda + Two-minute drills (ordered by priority)
1) Dedicated EU throughput and burst ask (owner: Ravi) — 8 min total
   - One-liner: throughput gap is 18% vs target for 10k rps sustained; short-term software scheduling + spot capacity can close ~12%.
   - Data to cite: qps baseline: 8.2k, target: 10k, current p95 latency at 60ms (target 50ms).
   - Proposal: approve $45k one-time burst (2 weeks) to bridge until autoscale policy deployed.
   - Ask: yes/no on spend and authority to sign up to cloud burst.

2) Private pilot compliance (owner: Maya) — 10 min
   - One-liner: GRC flagged data-retention clause and KMS proof-of-control; legal provided redlines but needs product sign-off.
   - Blocker: security engineering needs an extra engineer (contractor) to finalize HSM integration proof-of-concept by Jun 2.
   - Ask: approve contractor hire (est. 6 weeks).

3) Hosted API performance wins and rollout plan (owner: Jonah) — 6 min
   - One-liner: batching kernel changes reduced token costs by 6% and improved cold-start p99 by ~15% across small models.
   - Rollout: staggered canary today 10:00 PT -> full rollout Fri. No rollback indicators yet.
   - Ask: sign-off to proceed with full rollout Friday unless any exec objects.

4) Sales / pilots pipeline sanity check (owner: Ava) — 6 min
   - One-liner: three pilot deals at risk if compliance not closed; revenue at stake ~ $350k in ARR over 12 months.
   - Ask: agree on customer messaging (fallback SLA + timeline) and designate single comms owner.

5) Ops signal & incident backlog (owner: SRE lead) — 6 min
   - One-liner: incident backlog down to 4 medium items; prioritization needed for a high-impact KV cache bug.
   - Ask: approve reallocation of one FTE from infra platform to SRE for two sprints.

Two-minute 1:1 prep snippets (for chiefs doing rapid touchpoints this week)
- Ravi with infra eng (Wed 30m): confirm cloud burst budget cap and contingency thresholds; ask him to surface any long-lead infra procurements.
- Maya with GRC (Thu 20m): get a concrete list of GRC deliverables that would unblock pilots (by category: legal, infra, product).
- Jonah with DX (Fri 15m): ensure SDK docs match API changes; if not, delay rollout by 24h.

Risks / Red flags (short bullets)
- GRC/legal redlines could delay pilot GA by 3–4 weeks if contractor not approved this week.
- EU burst spend not approved -> potential customer throttling and SLA misses for two top-tier customers.
- Rollout telemetry gaps: missing trace-level for canary route in region eu-west; add temporary hook before full rollout.

Suggested customer-facing lines (one-liners for CS/sales)
- If compliance question: “We’re finalizing an HSM proof for the pilot customers — committed timeline is two weeks once staffing is approved.”
- If capacity: “We have a short-term burst plan to preserve performance while our autoscaler is deployed.”

Parking lot (for follow-ups after the exec sync)
- Deep-dive: Autoscaler policy schedule and assumptions (ops / infra)
- Postmortem: recent KV cache regression — SRE owner TBD
- Pricing: quick sketch of Dedicated overage options for customers hitting bursts

Action items (clear owner + due date)
- Approve Dedicated EU burst spend ($45k) — Owner: Ava — Due: 2024-05-20 — Status: pending exec approval
- Approve contractor for HSM integration (6 weeks) — Owner: Maya — Due: 2024-05-21 — Status: needs headcount approval
- Proceed with Hosted API full rollout Fri unless objections — Owner: Jonah — Due: 2024-05-24 — Status: canary running
- Publish customer pilot fallback message and send to sales — Owner: CS lead (Elena) — Due: 2024-05-21 — Status: draft
- Add trace hook to canary route (eu-west) — Owner: Platform eng — Due: 2024-05-20 — Status: open

Notes to self (quick reminders)
- Bring up the alternative of a shorter pilot SLA if legal pushes back on retention language — might preserve deals.
- Keep the ask minimal in the meeting: two approvals max; anything else into async follow-ups.
- After meeting: drop a 2–3 line summary in #exec-briefing and tag the three owners with due dates.

End of pocket briefing. Keep this on your phone — two-minute read before walking into the room.

Timestamp: 2024-05-18 07:30 PT — Ava M.
